reviewedExceptions.reason: Sharp distributes these platform-specific libvips binaries as unmodified optional dependencies; the application does not copy or modify libvips source. Distribution must retain the package's license notices.
Next.js uses Lightning CSS as an unmodified build/runtime dependency. MPL file-level obligations remain isolated to the dependency and its notices must be retained.
Browserslist consumes the Can I Use compatibility dataset as an unmodified dependency. Distribution must preserve attribution and the upstream license notice.

The neutral starter self-hosts the unmodified Geist font package so production builds never fetch Google Fonts. Distribution must retain the SIL Open Font License notice; merchants may replace the font through the theme system.
